title: Drawing of random world
content: I drew this a few days ago... it's somewhere I travel to often. To explain a bit, my childhood elementary school is across from a cemetery (in dream & IRL) but the cemetery in the dream is exaggerated. There are huge tombstones & statues. I just realized I did not sketch out the playground that's located in the cemetery - has a huge hill & old wooden/metal jungle gym. In the far left corner of the cemetery lies the haunted victorian mansion (I've posted about the mansion before). There's an intersection nearby that leads to different worlds. The road that's "broken" is usually either very steep/treacherous, on fire etc.-something crazy. Grocery store world is down that road. If you turn left out of the elementary school, I always end up in a hilly maze of roads. It reminds me of being in the video game 'grand theft auto' for some reason. There's another small cemetery off the hill with a small house that stands alone. Driving further, you reach a desert-like area. I can picture the desert in my head but it's very, very hard to describe. Off in the distance is a parking garage and possibly an airport? https://preview.redd.it/salz1fsj4dk91.jpg?width=4032&format=pjpg&auto=webp&s=d43d0a8aec555aadd67f039a42af7a03f62c07b0
